prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS C1 ON T1."XCL_022" = C1."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN colour AS C2 ON T1."XCL_023" = C2."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
WHERE T1."XCL_029" IS NULL
  AND C1."XCL_006" = 'Blue'
  AND C2."XCL_006" = 'Brown'
  AND T3."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY T2."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
